title: KYC submissions failing

acceptableCauses.mechanism: The kyc-service 1.16.0 release at 11:05 IST introduced the errors that began two minutes later. Its deploy record was written in IST without an offset and indexed as UTC, so it appears at 16:35 IST, after the errors.

partialCredit.reason: Finds the timestamp skew but names it as the cause instead of the release.

requiredEvidence.description: error logs carrying the new version

keyCounterevidence: Error logs from 11:07 IST carry version 1.16.0, so the new build was already running before the "16:35 IST" deploy time.
The deploy record has no UTC offset (tz: none); read as IST it is 5.5 h earlier.
redHerrings: reporter ruled the release out from the deploy log
